a16z-mind-robotics:ashbyhq:45d92210-c1b2.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior Safety Engineer who can own functional safety end-to-end for our humanoid platform: hazard analysis, architectural decisions, component selection, certification, and the messy real-world testing in between. Standards like ISO 3691-4, and ISO 10218 tell you what outcomes you must achieve.
